summary: Attempted to test the new POS transaction date-picker feature. Discovered the feature has NOT been implemented at all — neither in backend nor frontend. No transaction_date field exists in TransactionIn or create_transaction; no txnDate state, no datetime-local input, and no `pos-txn-date` / `pos-txn-date-clear` test-ids in POS.jsx. Verified via grep across /app/backend and /app/frontend/src: zero matches for `transaction_date`, `txnDate`, or `pos-txn-date`. No point running Playwright/pytest for this feature.

critical.issue: TransactionIn does not include optional `transaction_date`. create_transaction always sets `created_at = now_iso()`. There is no ISO parsing, no 400 for invalid input, no override behaviour. Entire backend piece of this feature is missing.

ui_bugs.issue: No `txnDate` state, no datetime-local Input under 'Nama Pembeli', no `data-testid=pos-txn-date`, no `data-testid=pos-txn-date-clear` reset link. The `complete()` handler does not send `transaction_date` in the POST payload.

integration_issues.issue: Feature cannot be exercised end-to-end because neither UI control nor backend field exists.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: Actually implement the feature. Currently no code was written for it.

Backend: Add `transaction_date: Optional[str] = None` to TransactionIn. In create_transaction, if provided (non-empty), parse via datetime.fromisoformat (handle trailing 'Z' by replacing with '+00:00'); on failure raise HTTPException(400, 'Format tanggal transaksi tidak valid'); convert to UTC and store as ISO string in `created_at`. If null/empty/missing → use now_iso().

Frontend POS.jsx: Add `const [txnDate, setTxnDate] = useState('')`. Under the Nama Pembeli block add: Label 'Tanggal Transaksi' with inline reset link `data-testid=pos-txn-date-clear` (visible only when txnDate !== '') that calls setTxnDate(''). Below it an `<Input type="datetime-local" data-testid="pos-txn-date" value={txnDate} onChange=...>`. In `complete()` include `transaction_date: txnDate ? new Date(txnDate).toISOString() : null` in the POST body. After successful checkout call setTxnDate('').
Ensure reports/transactions date-range filters use `created_at` (they already do) — will work automatically once override is applied.
Once implemented, re-request testing so full E2E + pytest coverage can be executed.
critical_code_review_comments: Feature described in the review_request is entirely absent from the codebase. main agent likely forgot to save or committed to wrong branch.
server.py is 1240+ lines — consider splitting routers by resource (auth/products/transactions/reports) for maintainability.

Backend CORS is `allow_origins=['*']` with `allow_credentials=False` yet login sets an httpOnly cookie — cookie will never be sent by browser from the frontend origin because credentials aren't allowed. Frontend appears to rely on Bearer token via localStorage. If cookie auth is intended, tighten origins and set allow_credentials=True.
create_transaction uses `count_documents({}) + 1` to build txn_number — race-prone under concurrent checkouts; consider a MongoDB counters collection with findOneAndUpdate $inc.
seed_data_creation: None. No transactions created because feature is not implemented — nothing to clean up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once main agent actually implements the datetime picker in POS.jsx and adds transaction_date handling in server.py's TransactionIn + create_transaction, test: (1) POST /api/transactions with transaction_date '2025-06-15T10:00:00Z' → created_at starts with '2025-06-15T'. (2) transaction_date='tidak-valid' → 400 with 'Format tanggal transaksi tidak valid'. (3) transaction_date null/omitted → created_at = today. (4) GET /api/reports?start_date=2025-06-01&end_date=2025-06-30 must include the backdated txn. (5) Frontend E2E: set customer 'DATE_QA_TEST', pick 2025-06-15T10:00 in `[data-testid=pos-txn-date]`, Complete Order, verify created transaction and that field auto-resets to ''. Clean up by DELETE /api/transactions/{id} for any customer_name starting with DATE_QA_TEST.
rca of the issue: Root cause: The main agent's review_request describes code changes to /app/backend/server.py (TransactionIn.transaction_date, parsing to UTC ISO, 400 on invalid) and /app/frontend/src/pages/POS.jsx (txnDate state + datetime-local Input + reset link + payload wiring), but git log shows the last non-trivial code commit was WhatsApp integration (855efbe); the only commit after that (f9a5eea 'Auto-generated changes') only touched .emergent/emergent.yml, .gitconfig, .gitignore. Grep for `transaction_date`, `txnDate`, `pos-txn-date` across /app/backend and /app/frontend/src returns zero hits. Reproduction: `grep -rn 'transaction_date\|txnDate\|pos-txn-date' /app/backend /app/frontend/src` → empty. Mitigation: main agent must (re)apply the intended edits and commit them, then re-invoke the testing agent.
